channel.title: frontier-wire
channel.description: An openly automated bilingual news wire (RU+EN): AI, tech, science, world, culture.

item.title: OpenAI закрывает каталог скиллов для Codex — как раз когда скилл-паки бьют рекорды на GitHub / OpenAI shuts down its Codex skills catalog just as third-party skill packs blow up on GitHub
item.description: The official repo got tagged "deprecated" and redirected to plugins, while a third-party marketing-skills catalog picked up hundreds of stars in a single day. (source: https://github.com/openai/skills)

item.title: Учёным сделали «домашнюю лабораторию» для ИИ-агентов — теперь со Slurm и менеджером литературы / Scientists get a local AI research workbench — now with Slurm clusters and a reference library
item.description: Open Science just shipped version 0.26.0, adding HPC cluster support, a literature manager, and 22 ready-made skills like AlphaFold2 and DiffDock. (source: https://github.com/aipoch/open-science)

item.title: Европа наконец запустила свою первую полностью коммерческую орбитальную ракету / Europe finally launches its first fully commercial orbital rocket
item.description: Germany's Isar Aerospace succeeded where a March attempt ended in an explosion 30 seconds after liftoff. (source: https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/09/german-company-becomes-first-in-europe-to-launch-fully-commercial-orbital-rocket/)

item.title: Экзитполы дают крайне правым уверенную победу на региональных выборах в Германии / Exit polls give Germany's far right a commanding lead in a regional election
item.description: NPR reports Germany's AfD is ahead in exit polls, with it still unclear whether the party can form the country's first state government since World War II. (source: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/06/nx-s1-5955677/german-afd-far-right-exit)

item.title: Учёные связали подростковую изоляцию с почти миллионом британской молодёжи «вне системы» / Researchers link teenage social isolation to nearly a million UK youth falling out of the system
item.description: About a million young Britons are neither in education, employment, nor training — new research points to social isolation as one of the drivers. (source: https://phys.org/news/2026-09-socially-isolated-linked-young-people.html)

item.title: Ратуша Дарема, которая служит городу с 1350 года, снова открыла двери — с аудиогидами / Durham's town hall has served the city since 1350 — now it's reopened, audio guides included
item.description: After refurbishment, an English town hall that's been central to civic life for nearly seven centuries is open to visitors again. (source: https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/durham-town-hall)

item.title: Грузовой Boeing 767 с логотипом Amazon выкатился за полосу в Майами — погибли пять человек / An Amazon-branded Boeing 767 overran the runway in Miami — five people are dead
item.description: The plane ran off the runway while landing on Sunday and crashed into parked vehicles; the FAA is investigating. (source: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/06/nx-s1-5959749/amazon-cargo-plane-crashes-at-miami-airport)

item.title: После восьми лет полёта BepiColombo выходит на финальный подход к Меркурию / After eight years in flight, BepiColombo is on final approach to Mercury
item.description: The joint ESA/JAXA mission will be only the third in history to study the Sun's nearest planet. (source: https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/09/after-8-years-europes-bepicolombo-mission-is-on-final-approach-to-mercury/)

item.title: Учёные превратили магнитное поле Земли в детектор тёмной материи размером с планету / Scientists turned Earth's magnetic field into a planet-sized dark-matter detector
item.description: Researchers sharply tightened limits on ultralight axions — and turned up odd signals that could be dark photons. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260904000328.htm)

item.title: Популярную аминокислоту из спортивных добавок связали с сокращением жизни у мужчин / A popular sports-supplement amino acid has been linked to shorter lifespans in men
item.description: A study of more than 270,000 people found a link between high blood tyrosine and shorter lifespans in men. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260904000330.htm)

item.title: Seattle Times и Newsday подали в суд на OpenAI и Microsoft за использование своих статей / The Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft over their journalism
item.description: The outlets allege their reporting was used as training data without permission, and that the models sometimes reproduce whole passages of text. (source: https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/990932/seattle-times-newsday-lawsuit-openai-microsoft)

item.title: Маппетам — 50 лет: шоу, задуманное как скромный варьете, стало одним из главных телефеноменов / The Muppets turn 50 — a modest variety show that became one of TV's biggest phenomena
item.description: The first episode of "The Muppet Show" aired in the UK on September 5, 1976; fifty years on, enthusiasm for it hasn't faded. (source: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smithsonian-institution/kermit-the-frog-was-just-trying-to-put-on-a-variety-show-fifty-years-later-the-muppets-are-some-of-the-biggest-stars-in-television-history-180989451/)

item.title: SGLang снова в трендах GitHub — и растёт куда правдоподобнее конкурентов / SGLang is trending on GitHub again — and growing far more plausibly than its rivals
item.description: The engine for fast LLM serving added 1,237 stars in a day; the project claims a 25x inference speedup on new NVIDIA hardware. (source: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang)

item.title: Тренды GitHub заполонили надстройки для Claude Code — но верить их счётчикам звёзд стоит по-разному / GitHub's trending page is full of Claude Code add-ons — and their star counts deserve very different levels of trust
item.description: Three separate Claude Code tooling projects hit the trending page on the same day: the loudly-pitched ruflo, a compact skill pack from HumanLayer, and a production toolkit from an Anthropic hackathon winner. (source: https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo)

item.title: На GitHub набирает популярность каталог из 200+ инструментов, которые не просят регистрацию / A GitHub directory of 200+ tools that never ask you to sign up is picking up steam
item.description: The NoSignups project (formerly FckSignups) catalogs open-source web tools with no accounts, cookies, or analytics — and has grown to 2.9k stars on plain frustration with sign-up walls. (source: https://github.com/BraveOPotato/FckSignups)

item.title: Когда ИИ дообучает сам себя, ему нужно уметь забывать чужой опыт / When AI retrains itself, it needs to know which lessons not to keep
item.description: A new paper asks autonomous post-training systems to decide not just what to reuse from past attempts, but when reusing nothing at all is the right call. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.26730)

item.title: Клетки под микроскопом слипаются — новый метод учится их всё-таки различать / Cells overlap under the microscope — a new method learns to tell them apart anyway
item.description: QCell tackles a long-standing microscopy problem: semi-transparent, overlapping cells blur boundaries even for algorithms designed to find them. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.29253)

item.title: «Оптимизируй окно контекста, остальное запомни» — ещё одна попытка приручить ИИ-агентов / Optimize the context window. Persist everything else." — another attempt to tame AI coding agents
item.description: The ECC repository promises to turn a chaotic AI agent into a disciplined engineer: plan, test, review, memory — 68 agents and 286 skills instead of one long prompt. (source: https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC)

item.title: Не всё, что в трендах GitHub, — новый ИИ-хайп: библиотеке форматирования строк уже больше десяти лет / Not everything trending on GitHub is fresh AI hype — this string-formatting library is over a decade old
item.description: {fmt} has spent over a decade quietly speeding up C++ code in MongoDB, PyTorch, and Windows Terminal — and today it's back on the trending page. (source: https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt)

item.title: «Квантизационное исцеление»: сжатая модель обошла собственный оригинал / Quantization-aware healing": a shrunk model outperforms its own original
item.description: Multiverse Computing unveiled a 4-bit version of a model that reportedly beats its own full-precision original — a rare case where compression doesn't cost quality but appears to add it. (source: https://huggingface.co/blog/MultiverseComputingCAI/quantization-aware-healing)

item.title: Поиск на Papers with Code теперь работает на собственной инфраструктуре Hugging Face / Papers with Code's search now runs on Hugging Face's own infrastructure
item.description: Hugging Face explained how its Inference Endpoints, Jobs, and Buckets now serve search on Papers with Code — swapping a third-party stack for its own product lineup. (source: https://huggingface.co/blog/pwc-search)

item.title: «Skills» для ИИ-агентов ворвались в тренды GitHub — сразу два репозитория / Skills" for AI agents storm GitHub's trending page — two repos at once
item.description: Anthropic's skills repository picked up 277 stars in a day and cracked GitHub's top five trending — right next to an unrelated project built on the same idea. (source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills)

item.title: Миллиарды токенов из старых газет: как ИИ учится на архивах / Billions of tokens from old newsprint: teaching AI on the archives
item.description: Researchers unveiled a pipeline that turns digitized historical newspapers into high-quality training data for language models. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.18972)

item.title: Судьи для ИИ-агентов сами не проходили экзамен / The judges grading AI agents haven't been graded themselves
item.description: A new benchmark called AgentJudgeBench tests how much you can actually trust the LLMs that grade other AI agents. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.26623)

item.title: Не «похоже», а «то самое»: как научить ИИ узнавать редкие объекты на фото / Not "looks like" but "is that": teaching AI to recognize rare objects in photos
item.description: A new entity-alignment method targets visual questions where plain image-similarity search keeps missing the mark. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.21450)

item.title: DeepSeek выкатила свой agent-фреймворк — и сразу с 211 тысячами звёзд / DeepSeek ships its own agent framework — and it already has 211,000 stars
item.description: DeepSeek Harness is built on an "everything is a plugin" principle and gained over 1,500 new GitHub stars in a single day. (source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

item.title: Плагин учит ИИ-агентов думать как «ленивый синьор»: минус 54% кода / A plugin teaches AI agents to think like a "lazy senior dev": 54% less code
item.description: Ponytail makes an agent check for an existing solution before writing anything — its authors claim a 54% cut in generated code and 20% savings on tokens. (source: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)

item.title: Сборник инструментов для обхода цензуры взлетел в топ-11 трендов GitHub / A censorship-circumvention toolkit jumps into GitHub's top 11 trending repos
item.description: fanqiang, a collection of guides and apps for bypassing internet restrictions, gained 539 stars in a day — outpacing far more conventional AI projects on the same list. (source: https://github.com/bannedbook/fanqiang)

item.title: Можно ли научить рекомендательного бота вести диалог без единого примера диалога / Can you teach a recommendation bot to hold a conversation without a single example dialogue
item.description: A new study systematically tests whether conversational recommender systems can work in domains with zero labeled training dialogues. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2504.15476)

item.title: ChatGPT, Grok и Claude легли одновременно — и это неудобный вопрос / ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude went down together — and that's the story
item.description: The world's three biggest chatbots stopped responding at the same time. (source: https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/989503/chatgpt-grok-claude-outage-down)

item.title: OpenAI впервые признала модель «критически опасной» для кибербезопасности / OpenAI just called one of its own models a critical cybersecurity risk
item.description: Astra is the first OpenAI model to cross the company's own "critical" cybersecurity threshold. (source: https://openai.com/index/path-to-astra)

item.title: Google обновил ИИ-модель прогноза погоды — и обещает точность нового уровня / Google says its AI weather model just got sharper
item.description: Google's updated WeatherNext model promises better rain and snow forecasts. (source: https://www.theverge.com/tech/988921/weather-forecast-ai-model-google-satellite-update)

item.title: Репозиторий Anthropic со «скиллами» для агентов взлетел в топ GitHub за день / Anthropic's "Agent Skills" repo shot up GitHub's trending charts overnight
item.description: anthropics/skills is a fresh new entry on GitHub's trending page, with 277 stars in a single day. (source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills)

item.title: У Сатурна нашли десятиугольник на южном полюсе — и он растёт / Saturn just grew a ten-sided storm at its south pole, and it's getting stronger
item.description: A giant ten-sided atmospheric pattern has shown up at Saturn's south pole, a southern counterpart to its famous hexagon. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260903064229.htm)

item.title: Трамп говорит про 30 танкеров в день через Ормузский пролив. Данные так не считают / Trump says 30 tankers a day cross Hormuz. The tracking data disagrees
item.description: Ship-tracking data doesn't match the US administration's claims about traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. (source: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/3/how-much-oil-is-going-through-hormuz-how-data-doesnt-match-us-claims?traffic_source=rss)

item.title: Погоне на паровозе из фильма Бастера Китона — сто лет, и её до сих пор празднуют на месте съёмок / Buster Keaton's train chase turns 100 — and fans are gathering where it happened
item.description: The 100th anniversary of filming Keaton's The General is being marked at the actual filming site in Cottage Grove, Oregon. (source: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/03/nx-s1-5921324/the-general-buster-keaton-anniversary)

item.title: Anthropic публикует системные промпты Claude — и там неожиданно много про тексты песен / Anthropic publishes Claude's system prompts — and song lyrics get oddly special treatment
item.description: The company openly publishes the instructions behind Claude.ai and its mobile apps, changelog included. (source: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/2/claudes-new-system-prompt/)

item.title: Жертвы бойни в Шарпевиле спустя 66 лет требуют компенсации от властей ЮАР / Sharpeville massacre victims are suing South Africa for compensation, 66 years on
item.description: A claim over the 1960 killings is part of a fresh wave of lawsuits over apartheid-era crimes. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/03/victims-sue-south-african-government-sharpeville-massacre-apartheid)

item.title: Учёные впервые сфотографировали архею-«археарда» в тесной связке с бактерией / Scientists photographed an Asgard archaeon physically linked to a bacterium for the first time
item.description: A find inside ancient stromatolite communities may show how complex life first got its start. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260902234514.htm)

item.title: Взял машину в аренду — через несколько часов его права продавали на даркнет-сайте / He rented a car — within hours his driver's license was for sale on a new dark web site
item.description: A new dark web marketplace is selling 153 million driver's licenses, and the FBI is reportedly investigating. (source: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/09/my-drivers-license-is-one-of-153-million-for-sale-on-a-new-dark-website/)
